assertion.text: Erdős Problem #1049: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $t>1$ be a rational number. Is\[\sum_{n=1}^\infty\frac{1}{t^n-1}=\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\tau(n)}{t^n}\]irrational, where $\tau(n)$ counts the divisors of $n$? Current best: Erd\H{o}s \cite{Er48} proved that this is true if $t\geq 2$ is an integer. Prize: no. Tags: irrationality.
